Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as strong inflation data cements rate-hike bets
Markets.summary: US stocks ended higher on Friday as accelerating consumer prices strengthened expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike next week. Meanwhile, oil prices fell on the day but remained sharply higher for the week due to Middle East supply concerns.

Markets.title: Demat 2.0 will bring instant bond settlement closer, trading after regulation and market readiness: NSDL MD
Markets.summary: NSDL Managing Director Vijay Chandok stated that Demat 2.0 could enable instant bond settlements and tokenized bond delivery using central bank digital currency. However, implementing this system depends on necessary regulatory approval and overall market readiness.

Markets.title: BlackRock private credit fund sees redemption pressure ease in third quarter
Markets.summary: BlackRock's flagship private credit fund experienced lower withdrawal requests in the third quarter compared to previous periods. This decrease in redemption pressure signals improving sentiment and a clearing backlog for the sector and asset managers.

Markets.title: Granules India promoter sells 1.72 crore shares worth Rs 1,500 crore; Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas among investors
Markets.summary: Granules India promoter Krishna Prasad Chigurupati sold 1.72 crore shares for approximately Rs 1,500 crore to institutional investors like Goldman Sachs and BNP Paribas. The transaction reduced the promoter's stake to 31.08% to fund the second tranche of a preferential issue.

Markets.title: Fed rate-hike bets rise to 85% after hot August inflation data
Markets.summary: August core consumer prices and rising oil prices exceeded expectations, signaling an upward trend in inflation. Consequently, traders estimate an 85% chance that the Federal Reserve will implement a quarter-point rate hike at its next meeting.

Markets.title: Gold climbs on dip buying, Fed hike bets rise after US inflation data
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose over one percent on Friday due to dip buying and found a short-term floor. Strong U.S. inflation data increased expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike next week.

Geo-Political.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
Geo-Political.summary: The Iran-backed Houthis claimed a major military advance in Yemen, including the seizure of the strategic island of Perim. This action tightens the group's control over the critical Red Sea shipping lane.

Geo-Political.title: Tragic death of woman who testified against father in notorious mafia murder of mother
Geo-Political.summary: Denise Cosco has died after previously testifying against her father and the powerful 'Ndrangheta mafia clan regarding her mother's murder in Italy. Her testimony had been a crucial part of the high-profile case against the criminal organization.

Geo-Political.title: Passenger train derails in France leaving at least 44 injured
Geo-Political.summary: A passenger train operating the Rouen-Caen route in Normandy derailed with 180 people on board. The accident left at least 44 people injured, according to France's transport minister.

Geo-Political.title: Arrest made over the death of black woman found hanged from tree
Geo-Political.summary: An arrest has been made regarding the death of Tasia Fortune, a Black woman whose body was found hanged from a tree in Mississippi last August. Authorities have taken a suspect into custody, though further details about the arrest have not yet been fully released.

Geo-Political.title: Norway's Princess Astrid dies two days after attending brother King Harald's funeral
Geo-Political.summary: Norway's Princess Astrid has died at the age of XX, just two days after attending the funeral of her brother, King Harald. The new monarch, King Haakon VIII, paid tribute to his aunt for warmly and dutifully representing the Royal House.

Geo-Political.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
Geo-Political.summary: Israel stated that it destroyed a major underground Hezbollah base in Lebanon. The blast was so powerful that the US Geological Survey recorded it as the equivalent of a magnitude 4.1 earthquake.

Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged BRICS nations to reduce trade barriers, deepen investments, and secure sea lanes. He also presented India's infrastructure, startups, and digital public infrastructure as drivers of global growth.

Data & Insights.title: Modi meets Pezeshkian amid US-Iran War: Seafarers’ safety in West Asia, BRICS cooperation discussed
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit in New Delhi. The two leaders discussed strengthening India-Iran relations, cooperation in multilateral forums, and the safety of seafarers amid the ongoing conflict in West Asia.

Data & Insights.title: India’s 7.8% Q1 GDP growth ‘above our expectations’, says IMF amid energy price shock
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF reported that India's economy grew by a better-than-expected 7.8% in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. This strong performance, supported by improved data transparency, highlights India's role as a major global growth engine despite ongoing energy price shocks.

Data & Insights.title: In New Delhi, Putin pitches BRICS investment platform, says bloc’s growth outpaces G7 - ‘World is always changing’
Data & Insights.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin pitched a new BRICS digital investment platform in New Delhi to mobilize private funding and boost competitiveness. He also highlighted that the bloc's economic growth is now outpacing the G7 nations.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: From trade to defence, energy and space - What transpired during Modi-Putin meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin met at the BRICS Summit to review bilateral cooperation. According to the Ministry of External Affairs, the discussions covered political, economic, defence, energy, space, skills mobility, and people-to-people domains.

Data & Insights.title: Modi-Putin meet: $100 billion trade target by 2030, nuclear energy, critical minerals likely focus areas, says report
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Modi and President Putin are expected to set an ambitious bilateral trade target of $100 billion by 2030. Their upcoming meeting will also likely focus on expanding cooperation in nuclear energy and critical minerals.

India.title: Fire Breaks Out At Old Central Theatre Near Madurai Meenakshi Temple
India.summary: A fire broke out at the Central Theatre complex in Madurai. The historic cinema is located near the western tower of the Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple.

India.title: 'US, Israel Want To Bully Us, But We Won't Kneel': Iran President In Delhi
India.summary: During a visit to Delhi, Iran's president criticized the United States and Israel for attempting to bully his nation while declaring that Iran would not submit. India.title: At BRICS Summit, PM Modi, UN Chief Discuss Need To Reform Global Bodies
